questions.q: ------- the new software was installed last week, employees have reported fewer system errors.
questions.why: 後ろが節で、現在完了と呼応して「〜して以来」の意味になる Since が入る。During と Despite は前置詞、Rather は副詞。

questions.q: Ms. Ito will review the budget ------- the board meeting begins on Thursday.
questions.why: 後ろに「主語＋動詞」が続くので接続詞が必要で、「始まる前に」の意味になる before が入る。他は前置詞。

questions.q: The clinic will remain open late ------- patients can visit after work.
questions.why: 「〜できるように」と目的を表して節をつなぐのは so that。in order は that がないと節を導けない。

questions.q: ------- the registration fee is nonrefundable, participants may transfer their place to a colleague.
questions.why: 後ろが節なので接続詞が必要。逆接の Although が文意に合う。残りは前置詞（句）か副詞。

questions.q: The maintenance crew will work ------- the weekend to avoid disturbing tenants.
questions.why: 「週末の間に」という期間を表す over the weekend が自然。

questions.q: All invoices must be submitted ------- the 5th of each month.
questions.why: 「〜までに（期限）」を表すのは by。

questions.q: Mr. Park was promoted ------- his outstanding sales record.
questions.why: 「〜のおかげで」と理由を表す owing to が文意に合う。

questions.q: The new branch is located ------- the post office and the public library.
questions.why: 2つの場所の間を表すので between。among は3つ以上のものに使う。

questions.q: Applicants ------- résumés were received after the deadline will not be considered.
questions.why: 後ろに名詞（résumés）が続き「その人の」という所有の意味なので whose。

questions.q: The report, ------- was prepared by the finance team, shows a steady rise in revenue.
questions.why: 先行詞は the report（物）で、直後に動詞が続く主格の関係代名詞 which が入る。カンマの後なので that は使えない。

questions.q: Please contact the manager ------- you spoke with yesterday.
questions.why: spoke with の目的語にあたる人を先行詞とする関係代名詞なので whom。

questions.q: The company's ------- to environmental protection has won several awards.
questions.why: 所有格 company's の後ろには名詞が入る。commitment to 〜 で「〜への取り組み」。

questions.q: Ms. Alvarez handled the customer complaint ------- and professionally.
questions.why: and professionally とそろえて動詞を修飾する副詞が入る。

questions.q: The ------- of the old warehouse will begin in March.
questions.why: 冠詞 The の後ろ、of の前なので名詞が入る。

questions.q: By the time the auditors arrive, we ------- all the records.
questions.why: By the time の節が現在形で未来のある時点を表すとき、主節は未来完了形になる。

questions.q: Employees are required ------- their ID badges at all times.
questions.why: be required to do の形で、不定詞が入る。

questions.q: The CEO wrote the speech ------- .
questions.why: 主語と同じ人を強調する再帰代名詞 himself が入る。

questions.q: The new model is ------- more efficient than the previous one.
questions.why: 比較級を強めるのは far や much。very、too、quite は比較級を直接修飾しない。

questions.q: The results of the customer survey ------- available on our Web site next week.
questions.why: 主語が複数形で、next week とあるので未来の複数に対応する形が入る。

questions.q: Not only ------- the contract on time, but she also negotiated a better price.
questions.why: Not only が文頭に出ると、助動詞が主語の前に来る倒置になる。

questions.q: The firm plans to ------- its operations to Southeast Asia next year.
questions.why: 「事業を拡大する」の意味になる expand が適切。

questions.q: Visitors are asked to ------- their belongings in the lockers provided.
questions.why: ロッカーに持ち物を「預ける・しまう」の意味で store が合う。

questions.q: The consultant gave a ------- presentation on cybersecurity risks.
questions.why: 「包括的な」発表という意味になる comprehensive が文脈に合う。

questions.q: Ticket prices are ------- to change without prior notice.
questions.why: be subject to 〜 で「〜される可能性がある」。

questions.q: The committee reached a ------- after three hours of discussion.
questions.why: reach a consensus で「合意に達する」。

questions.q: Please ------- the attached form and return it by Friday.
questions.why: 書類に「記入する」の意味で complete を使う。

questions.q: Ms. Tanaka was ------- for organizing the annual charity event.
questions.why: be responsible for 〜 で「〜を担当している」。

questions.q: The manager ------- the team for finishing the project ahead of schedule.
questions.why: 前倒しで終えたことを「称賛した」の意味で commended が合う。

questions.q: Sales figures for the third quarter were ------- higher than forecast.
questions.why: higher を修飾して「大幅に」を表す significantly が適切。

questions.q: The contract will ------- on December 31 unless both parties agree to renew it.
questions.why: 契約が「期限切れになる」の意味で expire。
後ろが「主語＋動詞」なので接続詞。「移転作業中は」の意味の While が入る。
「箱に入れて荷造りする」は pack 〜 in boxes。

c: Boxes that are not labeled may not be moved to the new location.

questions.why: 直前の「ラベルを付けた箱」の話を受け、ラベルのない箱の扱いを述べる文が自然につながる。
期限までに机を「空にする」の意味で vacate が合う。
後ろが名詞句（a shortage of 〜）なので前置詞句の because of が入る。because などは節を導く。

c: Several of our workshop employees recently received awards.
Please return the signed form to the accounting office.

questions.why: 配達日の変更を伝えた直後なので、遅れへのお詫びを述べる文が自然。
「到着の30分前に」は before arrival。
テーブルを「受け取る」ために誰かが在宅している必要がある。
先行詞は the project（物）で、直後に動詞 will cost が続くので主格の which。
「make＋目的語＋形容詞」の形で、形容詞が入る。比較級の easier が自然。

新しい自転車レーンが客を「引きつける」という文脈。
「以前は〜だったが今後は〜」という対比を表す接続詞 Whereas が合う。Despite は前置詞。
in の後ろに置いて前の名詞 survey を受ける関係代名詞は which。

Tideport Gazette — Business

BAYSIDE BREWERS TO OPEN SECOND LOCATION

TIDEPORT (June 8) — Bayside Brewers, a coffee roaster that began as a market stall five years ago, announced on Monday that it will open a second shop on Willow Street in September. The new location will have seating for 60 customers, twice as many as the original shop on Harbor Road.

Founder Marcus Oyelaran said the decision was driven by customers who often waited in long lines at the Harbor Road shop. "We kept running out of tables by 8 A.M.," he said. The company will hire 12 new employees, and it is currently accepting applications on its Web site.

Mr. Oyelaran added that the new shop will serve a small food menu, something the original location has never offered. Baked goods will be supplied by Crumb & Co., a bakery two blocks away.

Beginning September 1, all expense reports must be submitted through the new online system, Expenso, rather than on paper forms. Paper forms will no longer be accepted after September 15. Receipts must be scanned and uploaded along with each report; photographs taken with a phone are acceptable if the amounts are clearly legible.

Reports will be reviewed by the finance team within five business days, and approved amounts will be added to the next regular paycheck. Employees who need an account should contact the IT help desk at extension 204 by August 28. A training video is available on the company intranet.

Please share this information with your teams.

docs.text:
Hearthstone Bakery Plans Expansion into Marlow

MARLOW (March 12) — Hearthstone Bakery, based in Dunmore, will open its first branch in Marlow this May, company president Beatrice Kovacs announced Thursday. The 120-square-meter shop will be located in the Riverside Mall, next to the cinema, and will employ about 15 people. "Marlow has been asking for us for years," Ms. Kovacs said. "Our customers there often drive 40 minutes to buy our sourdough." Hearthstone, which was founded in 2012, now operates six branches. The company said the Marlow shop will open from 6 A.M. to 8 P.M. daily, the longest hours in its chain, to attract commuters and mall shoppers.
